explication: Stable Video Infinity (SVI) is a long-video generation system built on DiffSynth. The intended user-to-result path is prompt and conditioning input, video generation, then a rendered long-form video; README highlights extending video length while recycling generation error. The sampled Wan pipeline shows model, scheduler, prompt, and memory-management dependencies, but the SVI-specific pipeline and UI implementations were not sampled. Dashed, uncited links mark those uncertain runtime connections; the README excerpt does not document detailed implementation flow.
